cl.x: Provide Sika® Mix where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
Sika® Mix is a concrete admixture for general use to enhance unfavourable concrete mixes. Sika® Mix improves workability even with poor aggregates, and sand gradings.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.x: Sika® Mix is especially useful for concrete mixes with fluctuating fines, low cement content or unfavourable granulometric curves with bad water retention abilities. Even secondary raw materials like crushed rock and manufactured sands are more easily used with Sika® Mix.

s: Dispensing: Sika® Mix can be added either to the initial mixing water or to the slump water. Never add to a dry mix. The optimum effect is reached after a wet mixing time of 60 seconds/m³ .
Compatibility: Sika® Mix can be used in conjunction with all the Sika® Concrete and Sigunit® admixtures.
